description: Labels that say WHICH released module a bot pull request touches. Modules are released and
consumed independently, so the question before merging is 'what else is in flight for this
module', and a bot PR's title carries the module name only when a scope rule assigned one;
the label answers uniformly, from the path.
The vocabulary is shared with release-please: release-please-config.json sets
'subsystem:<component>' on each release PR, so one subsystem: filter shows a module's
pending bumps and pending release together. Keep the spellings identical; nothing
Triage facets only: no workflow or required check keys off a subsystem: label.

packageRules.description: apps-* modules, from path segment 2 -- same key release-please maps to the component name
bootstrap CRD copies -- literal, because path segment 2 is 'crds' here and the template above would render 'infra-crds'
shared components -- not a released module, but it is the surface a reviewer has to think about, and it rides every consuming module's next release
